title.narrative: Building Foundation for Sustainable HIV Response in Kazakhstan - Kazakhstan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Kazakhstan, HIV, Kazakh scientific center of dermatology and infectious diseases of the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan (KSCDID)This program has the following goals: To institutionalize social contracting system to scale up access of KAP to HIV prevention, care and support services.. The objectives of this program are: To institutionalize an innovative social contracting system for sustainable national HIV response. To scale-up evidence-based HIV prevention, care and support for key populations
